sentences.en: When Eric Carlson retired, he dove headfirst into an old hobby.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·卡尔森退休后，一头扎进了一个旧爱好里。

sentences.en: Philately is basically the love of stamps, and it involves all aspects of stamp collecting,
sentences.zh: 集邮基本上就是对邮票的热爱，它涵盖了邮票收藏的方方面面，
从初学者到专家皆是如此。

sentences.en: Aside from being my new favorite word,
sentences.zh: 除了成为我最喜欢的新词之外，

sentences.en: philately is a tragically underappreciated field of study.
sentences.zh: 集邮是一个被严重低估的学术领域。

sentences.en: A stamp can give you a perfect snapshot of the past in a single square inch of paper.
sentences.zh: 一张邮票可以在一平方英寸的纸上为你提供过去完美的缩影。

sentences.en: Of course, you've got the basic forever stamp with the flag waving on it.
sentences.zh: 当然，你有印着飘扬旗帜的基础永久邮票。

sentences.en: Then there are maritime stamps, commemorative stamps, architectural stamps,
sentences.zh: 还有海事邮票、纪念邮票、建筑邮票，

sentences.en: or my favorite, Cinderella's, which resemble real stamps,
sentences.zh: 或者我最喜欢的“灰姑娘邮票”，它们看起来像真正的邮票，

sentences.en: but can't be used for mail since they aren't issued by a postal authority.
sentences.zh: 但因为不是由邮政部门发行的，所以不能用于邮寄。

sentences.en: They're kind of like fan art.
Eric Carlson finds his stamps at the world's great supermarket for obscure collectibles.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·卡尔森在世界最大的冷门收藏品超市里寻找他的邮票。

sentences.en: And one day, he found this really odd-looking stamp.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他发现了一张看起来非常奇怪的邮票。
其实是一张“灰姑娘邮票”。

sentences.en: It's a very cumbersome-looking red bird in the middle with a yellow background.
sentences.zh: 中间是一只看起来很笨拙的红鸟，背景是黄色的。

sentences.en: Most official stamps are neat and tidy with clean lines, but not this one.
sentences.zh: 大多数正式邮票线条清晰、整洁美观，但这枚不是。

sentences.en: This stamp was kind of rough-looking.
sentences.zh: 这枚邮票看起来有点粗糙。

sentences.en: The lettering was hand-drawn, and the bird in the center was beautiful,
sentences.zh: 上面的字是手绘的，中间的鸟很漂亮，

sentences.en: They're very charming, just in their simplicity and their crudeness.
sentences.zh: 它们非常迷人，仅仅是因为它们的简洁和粗糙。

sentences.en: They're a joy to look at.
He also didn't recognize the letters across the top.
sentences.zh: 他也认不出顶部的字母。

sentences.en: At first, I thought it was an acronym for some nation that had escaped my attention.
sentences.zh: 起初，我以为这是某个我没注意到的国家的缩写。

sentences.en: But the G-B-L-A wasn't a nation, or a postal authority, or any type of government body.
sentences.zh: 但G-B-L-A不是一个国家，也不是邮政部门，更不是任何类型的政府机构。

sentences.en: It stood for the Great Bitter Lake Association.
Eric had stumbled upon the remnants of a forgotten bit of world history,
sentences.zh: 埃里克偶然发现了被遗忘的世界历史片段，

sentences.en: left over from a ragtag group of sailors, stranded at the center of a war.
sentences.zh: 这是一群被困在战争中心的乌合之众留下的。

sentences.en: All my life has been attached to the sea.
sentences.zh: 我的一生都与大海相连。

sentences.en: I'm more suited to sea life.
I don't think I'd be any good in an office scenario.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我不适合办公室环境。

sentences.en: I wouldn't fit in there, Vivian.
sentences.zh: 我融入不了那里，薇薇安。

sentences.en: As much as I want to tell you this is Michael Caine, it is not.
sentences.zh: 尽管我很想告诉你这是迈克尔·凯恩，但并不是。

sentences.en: Quite a senior citizen, as you can imagine, at 77.
sentences.zh: 如你所想，77岁已经是位高龄老人了。

sentences.en: Flack is retired now, but at the age of 16,
sentences.zh: 弗拉克现在退休了，但在16岁时，

sentences.en: he started a long career in the Merchant Navy working on commercial cargo ships,
sentences.zh: 他开始了在商用货船上工作的漫长商船队生涯，

sentences.en: And by his early 20s, he was ready to see something new.
sentences.zh: 二十出头时，他准备去看看新鲜事物。

sentences.en: I thought I wanted to see another part of the world, you know?
sentences.zh: 我想我想去看看世界的另一部分，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I thought, oh, the Far East is...
I'd like to see the Far EaSt.
In the mid-1960s, Flack was assigned on trade routes that took him from the U.K.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代中期，弗拉克被分配到从英国出发的贸易航线，

sentences.en: They'd haul everything from rubber to timber to toys.
sentences.zh: 他们运送各种货物，从橡胶、木材到玩具。

sentences.en: That's where we've discharged and then loaded up again.
sentences.zh: 那是我们卸货然后再次装货的地方。

sentences.en: And then on our way back to the U.K.
sentences.zh: 然后我们经由苏伊士运河返回英国，

sentences.en: via the Suez Canal, which was our normal route.
The Suez Canal is one of the busiest and most important shipping routes in the world.
sentences.zh: 苏伊士运河是世界上最繁忙、最重要的航运路线之一。

sentences.en: It connects the Red Sea to the Mediterranean,
allowing quick passage from Asia to Europe through the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 允许船只穿过中东，从亚洲快速到达欧洲。

sentences.en: While Flack's ship was busy delivering commercial goods from Singapore to the U.K.,
sentences.zh: 当弗拉克的船正忙着将商业货物从新加坡运往英国时，

sentences.en: tensions were escalating all around the canal.
sentences.zh: 运河周围的紧张局势正在升级。

sentences.en: There have been border disputes and skirmishes for years between Israel and its neighboring countries,
sentences.zh: 多年来，以色列与其邻国埃及、约旦和叙利亚之间一直存在边界争端和冲突。
但1967年6月5日，局势达到了临界点，“六日战争”爆发了。

sentences.en: But on June 5, 1967, things reached a breaking point, and the Six-Day War began.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，彼得·弗拉克和他的船“阿加皮诺号”正经由苏伊士运河回国，

sentences.en: Unfortunately for Peter Flack, he and his ship, the Agapinor, were on their way home via the Suez Canal,
sentences.zh: 而那里正处于冲突的核心。

sentences.en: which was right at the heart of the conflict.
We were in the line of ships.
sentences.zh: 我们的船是倒数第二艘。

sentences.en: Our ship was the last but one.
sentences.zh: 来自不同国家的船只一起编队通过是很常见的，

sentences.en: It was common for ships from different countries to pass through in a convoy together,
sentences.zh: 因为这样更容易控制交通。

sentences.en: because it was easier to control traffic that way.
sentences.zh: “阿加皮诺号”是编在一起的14艘货船和两艘油轮之一。

sentences.en: The Agapinor was one of 14 cargo ships and two tankers grouped together.
sentences.zh: 航行不久，船队进入了苏伊士运河的一段，称为大苦湖。

sentences.en: Not long into the journey, the convoy entered a section of the Suez called the Great Bitter Lake.
sentences.zh: 这是一个运河中一百平方英里的咸水水域。

sentences.en: It's a hundred-square-mile body of saltwater in the canal.
sentences.zh: 通常，像“阿加皮诺号”这样的船会在大苦湖抛锚几个小时，直到交通畅通。

sentences.en: Normally, a ship like the Agapinor would anchor in the Great Bitter Lake for a few hours until the traffic cleared.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，船要停留更久。

sentences.en: But this time, the ship would be staying much longer.
sentences.zh: 我在8点，也就是0800点接替了大副，好吗？

sentences.en: I relieved the chief officer at 8 o'clock, 0800, OK?
sentences.zh: 船长在船舱里，我们正向北穿过苏伊士运河南部。

sentences.en: The captain was in his cabin, and we were proceeding northbound through the southern part of the Suez Canal.
sentences.zh: 那是清晨，弗拉克刚在船桥上就位。

sentences.en: It was early morning, and Flack had just taken up his post on the bridge of the ship.
sentences.zh: 我上船桥后不久，船长就用传声筒叫我。

sentences.en: Shortly after I came on the bridge, the captain blew up to me.
sentences.zh: 我说用传声筒叫我，是因为当时没有现代通讯设备。

sentences.en: When I say blew up to me, we didn't have this modern communication.
sentences.zh: 就像一根管子，你把耳朵贴上去听。

sentences.en: There's like a pipe, so you put your ear to it.
sentences.zh: 总之，他说，彼得，我刚从BBC世界服务台听到战争爆发了。

sentences.en: Anyway, and he said, Peter, I've just heard on BBC World Service that war's broken out.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果你看到什么，告诉我。

sentences.en: He said, if you see anything, let me know.
sentences.zh: 弗拉克的第一个直觉是抓起他的相机。

sentences.en: Flack's first instinct was to grab his camera.
sentences.zh: 上午8点45分，以色列战机划破了宁静的早晨，

sentences.en: At 8.45 a.m., Israeli warplanes cut through the quiet morning
sentences.zh: 从东方快速低空飞来，直接从他头顶上方飞入埃及。

sentences.en: and shot in fast and low from the east, directly over his head into Egypt.
sentences.zh: 在之前的战争中，他们总是说如果发生袭击，

sentences.en: In the previous wars, they always used to say how the planes, if an attack would happen,
sentences.zh: 从太阳方向飞来会更有利，因为那样你就看不到它们飞来。

sentences.en: would be advantageous if they came out of the sun, you know, because then you couldn't see them arriving.
This is what exactly did happen.
sentences.zh: 它们从东方的太阳方向飞来。

sentences.en: They came out of the sun from the eaSt.
sentences.zh: 大约200名以色列战斗机飞行员利用初升太阳的低角度，

sentences.en: Around 200 Israeli fighter pilots used the low position of the rising sun
sentences.zh: 并以船队作为掩护，对埃及发动了突袭。

sentences.en: and the convoy of ships to mask a surprise blitz on Egypt.
sentences.zh: 飞机向西飞越苏伊士运河，直奔船队位置附近的一个埃及空军基地。

sentences.en: The planes were headed westward over the Suez Canal and straight for an Egyptian airbase near the convoy's position.
sentences.zh: 我们被卷入了，就我们而言，卷入了一个战区。

sentences.en: We were caught up in a, as far as we were concerned, in a war zone.
sentences.zh: 弗拉克和其余船员突然成了“六日战争”第一波攻击的前排观众。

sentences.en: Flack and the rest of the crew suddenly had front row seats to the first wave of the Six Day War.
sentences.zh: 船队从抛锚的位置看着，

sentences.en: The convoy of ships watched from their anchored positions
sentences.zh: 以色列喷气式飞机向地面上的埃及飞机开火并投掷导弹。

sentences.en: as Israeli jets unleashed gunfire and missiles on grounded Egyptian planes.
sentences.zh: 在那次轰炸之后，防空炮火响了起来。

sentences.en: And after that first bombing raid, there was Akak fire going on.
sentences.zh: 当他们离开时，以色列人在第一次突袭后离开，

sentences.en: And as they departed, the Israelis departed after that first raid,
sentences.zh: 他们再次飞过船队，再次利用船队作为盾牌，

sentences.en: they came back over the convoy and using this convoy once again as a shield
sentences.zh: 所以所有的防空炮火都朝我们打来。

sentences.en: so that all the Akak fire was coming towards us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都，你知道，我们都躲了起来。

sentences.en: So we all, you know, we all duck.
sentences.zh: 以色列声称在不到三小时内就在空中和地面摧毁了阿拉伯空军的主力。

sentences.en: Israel claims to have destroyed the bulk of the Arab air forces in the air and on the ground
sentences.zh: 所以埃及装备俄制武器的军队似乎已经被彻底击溃了。
令人惊讶的是，船队中没有人受伤。

sentences.en: So Egypt's Russian-equipped army appears to have been completely shattered.
sentences.zh: 但埃及空军已经被摧毁了。

sentences.en: Amazingly, no one in the convoy was hurt.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，苏伊士运河成为西侧埃及军队与东侧以色列军队的分界线，

sentences.en: But the Egyptian air force had been destroyed.
After the attack, the Suez Canal became the dividing line between Egyptian forces on the west side
sentences.zh: 船队被夹在两支交战的军队之间。

sentences.en: and Israeli forces on the east, with the Great Bitter Lake right in the middle.
sentences.zh: 这是《困在六日战争中》的作者凯丝·桑克。

sentences.en: The convoy was sandwiched between two warring armies.
sentences.zh: 战争进行时，我的意思是，他们通过无线电接到命令，

sentences.en: This is Kath Sanker, author of Stranded in the Six-Day War.
sentences.zh: 你知道，停在原地等待进一步指示。

sentences.en: With the war going on, I mean, they were ordered over the radio,
sentences.zh: 船队由商船组成，别无选择，只能服从埃及当局。

sentences.en: you know, to stop where they were and to await further instructions.
sentences.zh: 不到一周就达成了停火协议，但外交冲突却拖延了下来。

sentences.en: The convoy was made up of commercial ships and had no choice but to comply with Egyptian authorities.
sentences.zh: 埃及下令苏伊士运河完全停航。

sentences.en: A ceasefire was reached in less than a week, but the diplomatic conflict dragged on.
Egypt ordered a complete standstill of the Suez Canal.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们不想让以色列进入运河。
这是他们能做到的，因为他们控制着运河，

sentences.en: Firstly, they did not want Israel to have access to the canal.
sentences.zh: 他们可以控制交通，这样就没人能使用它，

sentences.en: It was something that they could do because they were in control of it
sentences.zh: 也没有敌对势力能进入那里。

sentences.en: and they could control the traffic and that way nobody could use it
sentences.zh: 即使这14艘船想违抗命令离开，

sentences.en: and no hostile power could get in there.
sentences.zh: 他们在物理上也做不到。

sentences.en: Even if the 14 ships wanted to go rogue and leave against orders,
sentences.zh: 埃及政府认为防止以色列使用运河的最好办法，

sentences.en: The Egyptian government figured the best way to prevent Israel from using the canal

sentences.zh: 他们倾倒了碎片，投入了地雷，

sentences.en: So, a few days after the conflict started,
sentences.zh: 并凿沉了旧船，使运河无法通行。

sentences.en: they dumped debris, threw in landmines,
and scuttled old ships to make the canal impassable.
sentences.zh: 几天后，当我们想，好吧，我们哪儿也去不了，

sentences.en: After a few days when we thought, well, we're not going anywhere here,
sentences.zh: 这14艘被困的船来自八个不同的国家。

sentences.en: you know, it's just a case of waiting.
sentences.zh: 英国、西德、波兰、捷克斯洛伐克、瑞典、法国、保加利亚，

sentences.en: The 14 trapped ships came from eight different countries.
The UK, West Germany, Poland, Czechoslovakia, Sweden, France, Bulgaria,
sentences.zh: 起初，船员们不知道发生了什么。
我们唯一的信息来源是世界服务台，

sentences.en: In the beginning, the crews didn't know what was going on.
The only information we got was through the World Service

sentences.zh: 我还有一封写给父母的信，让他们知道我什么时候能到家。

sentences.en: I've still got a letter to my parents so they knew when I'd be arriving home.
sentences.zh: 航运公司在幕后努力让船员回家，
而联合国则试图达成一项重新开放运河的协议。

sentences.en: the shipping companies were working in the background to get their crews home
sentences.zh: 中东六日战争在第二条战线上回响。

sentences.en: while the United Nations tried to work out a deal to reopen the canal.
sentences.zh: 联合国安理会的外交斗争。

sentences.en: The six-day Middle East war echoes along a second front.
sentences.zh: 一系列情绪激动的会议……

sentences.en: The diplomatic struggle at the United Nations Security Council.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，船只仍然没有被释放。

sentences.en: A series of emotionally charged meetings...
Months dragged on, and the boats still hadn't been released.
sentences.zh: 船队赢得了“黄舰队”的绰号，

sentences.en: They were stranded for so long,
sentences.zh: 因为该地区的沙尘暴染黄了船体。

sentences.en: the convoy earned the nickname the Yellow Fleet
sentences.zh: 日子过得如此之快，真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: because the sandstorms in the region stained the holes of the ships.
sentences.zh: 日子过得如此之快，真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: It's surprising how the days did pass, though.
sentences.zh: 日子过得如此之快，真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: There were others who didn't accept it, you know, biting at the bit.
sentences.zh: 还有些人并不接受这一点，你知道，他们急不可耐。

sentences.en: But I thought, well, this is our lot.
sentences.zh: 但我心想，好吧，这就是我们的命。

sentences.en: After three months of the crews trying to maintain their ships and their sanity,
sentences.zh: 在船员们努力维护船只和保持理智三个月后，

sentences.en: the shipping companies and the Egyptian government finally reached a compromise.
sentences.zh: 航运公司和埃及政府终于达成了一项妥协。

sentences.en: The people trapped on board were released,
sentences.zh: 被困在船上的人们获释了，

sentences.en: and Peter Flack and the rest of the stranded crew finally went home.
sentences.zh: 彼得·弗拉克和其余滞留的船员终于回到了家。

sentences.en: I got back home, I'd carried on as normal.
I was single, as I say.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我当时单身。

sentences.en: So I'd either go on to a dance, you know, meet a girl, you know, for three weeks, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我要么去跳舞，你知道，认识个女孩，你知道，交往三周，你知道，

sentences.en: and have a good time, and then go back to sea.
sentences.zh: 玩得开心，然后又回到海上。

sentences.en: But Egypt wouldn't reopen the canal,
sentences.zh: 但埃及拒绝重新开放运河，

sentences.en: so while the sailors could go home, the ships had to stay.
sentences.zh: 所以虽然水手们可以回家，但船只必须留下。

sentences.en: And the shipping companies didn't want to completely abandon their vessels.
sentences.zh: 航运公司也不想彻底放弃他们的船只。

sentences.en: So the logical thing to do was to keep people there to protect the valuable cargo
sentences.zh: 因此，合乎逻辑的做法是留人看守，以保护贵重货物

sentences.en: and the investment that they'd made in the ships.
sentences.zh: 以及他们在船上的投资。

sentences.en: Every shipping company decided to recruit new crew members
sentences.zh: 每家航运公司都决定招募新船员

sentences.en: to keep the vessels in working condition,
sentences.zh: 来保持船只处于可运行状态，

sentences.en: with the understanding that they would set sail the moment the passage reopened.
sentences.zh: 并达成共识：一旦航道重新开放，他们就会立即起航。

sentences.en: While Peter Flack was busy dancing with the ladies back home in Liverpool,
sentences.zh: 当彼得·弗拉克在利物浦老家忙着和女士们跳舞时，

sentences.en: a fresh batch of seafarers were sent to take his place.
sentences.zh: 一批新的海员被派去接替他的位置。

sentences.en: They couldn't wait to go home, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们也迫不及待地想回家。

sentences.en: So it was a new adventure for us, and we just took it up from there.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我们来说是一次新的冒险，我们就从那里开始了。

sentences.en: This is George Wharton, one of the members of that first relief crew.
sentences.zh: 这是乔治·沃顿，第一批救援船员的成员之一。

sentences.en: At the time, he was just 24 years old with a new wife and a baby on the way.
sentences.zh: 当时他才24岁，新婚燕尔，孩子也即将出生。

sentences.en: Even with the risk of being in a conflict zone,
sentences.zh: 即使身处冲突地区有风险，

sentences.en: going to the Great Bitter Lake was considered a pretty good gig.
sentences.zh: 去大苦湖也被认为是一份相当不错的工作。

sentences.en: Unlike the first wave of sailors caught in the Six-Day War,
sentences.zh: 与第一批被困在“六日战争”中的水手不同，

sentences.en: the replacement crews knew exactly what they were getting into,
sentences.zh: 接替的船员很清楚自己要面对什么，

sentences.en: and they were offered double pay because of the ever-present threat of war.
sentences.zh: 而且由于战争威胁始终存在，他们还获得了双倍工资。

sentences.en: It was classed as a good job, and people, when I was offered it,
sentences.zh: 这被归类为一份好工作，当有人向我提供这份工作时，

sentences.en: and we got around and said, oh, aren't you lucky, you know.
